posts.community: IDFC First Bank Limited - First Bank Preference for Long Term Investors too?
posts.text: Only Time will answer for that. As @Vineet_Bhatia sir mentioned, profits will be diluted due to largest equity. imo … Bank really needs to find a way to improve RoE without raising money at least 3 Qs without any negative surprises to have > 1.8x book value. Long term CI is still on higher side only, hope they reduce it soon. Its < 3% of PF and avg is closer to 1.02x book value, so I am okay for now. image 694×567 19.4 KB
